title: Task list entry af/task-list-entry@3
$comment: One common Task entry in the CLI list. Unfinished outcome, absent snapshot and absent delivery are explicit nulls. phase/result/delivery identity and charge consistency are checked by Store projection, not by this structural schema.

unknown_usage_attempts.description: Settled Attempts whose Provider reported no usage: each was charged zero and its usage is unknown (ADR-0143), so `chargeable_tokens` is not their spend. Absent when every usage is known. A collected Task's count is the one its tombstone retained.

cause.description: Present exactly when the Task is abandoned: unfinished, its lease neither held nor renewed, and its last run ended with an Attempt nobody settled or a node whose latest Attempt was abandoned (ADR-0197). `writer_lost`: the run's writer died or lost its lease, and the next writer settles or settled its Attempt; `host_cancelled`: SIGINT or SIGTERM stopped the run. `af task show` prints such a Task as `phase abandoned`; `phase` keeps the phase the Task recorded.

next_action.description: The command that continues an abandoned Task, present exactly with `cause`: `af task run TASK_ID`, or `af task start --file TASK_FILE` when the interrupted node used up its recovery allowance.

collected.description: Present exactly when the Task was collected by `af task gc --apply` (ADR-0135): its retained tombstone. Such an entry is finished, carries no derived Snapshot or delivery, has a zero footprint under `--sizes`, and its phase names the result its log recorded.

sizes.description: `af task list --sizes` only (ADR-0135): the CAS objects only this Task reaches, and those it shares with another Task or Campaign record; all zero for a collected Task.
